patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Comparison thesis: Same category, different company size. Choose Squarespace only if your buying job matches “Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo ” rather than VTEX's shape. Choose VTEX only if your buying job matches “Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. Shopify kee” rather than Squarespace's shape. Workflow advantage: Squarespace leans checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce; VTEX leans wholesale-b2b. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Squarespace is Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo annual (US 2026 tiles); platform transaction fees ; VTEX is Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. Shopify keeps the SaaS award..
- Company-size focus: Squarespace (solo, micro, small-business) vs VTEX (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Squarespace-leaning checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce vs VTEX-leaning wholesale-b2b.
- Researched limits: Squarespace — Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume; VTEX — No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone.

Limitations — Squarespace: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume; Catalog and B2B depth trail commerce-first platforms; VTEX: No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone; Enterprise sales and implementation cycles versus Shopify SMB speed.

Poor-fit cases: Squarespace is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume · VTEX is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone · Avoid Squarespace if you actually need VTEX's motion (Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. S)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
